text.tspan: FlashAttention: same maths, far fewer memory trips
The table grows with prompt length²
→ huge memory traffic on long prompts
Full table never written to HBM
EXACT same result · faster · far less memory
GPU kernel = a function that runs on the GPU across thousands of cores (not the Linux kernel).
Analogy: cook at the counter in small batches instead of walking to the storeroom after every step.
